mechanism: Both drugs can cause renal impairment and electrolyte abnormalities; ranolazine is renally cleared and zoledronic acid is nephrotoxic, increasing risk of ranolazine accumulation and toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR) and electrolytes regularly; ensure adequate hydration before zoledronic acid infusion; consider dose adjustment of ranolazine if renal function declines.
